In-app purchases (the quarterly subscription, its free trial and the one-time payment plan) are processed entirely through Apple's App Store or Google Play, with the account signed in on your device. Apple or Google handle payment and billing data according to their own privacy policies.
If you redeem a promo code, the redemption is also handled by Google Play. The app only receives from the store a signed confirmation of the purchase or redemption (which plan it is, when it started and when it renews or expires). That confirmation is checked on your own device to unlock %@ and is not sent to any developer server. The developer can see aggregated, anonymous sales reports in the Apple and Google dashboards, but not your identity or payment details.

The free version includes, among other things, farm timers, inventory, NFTs, the calculator, the calendar, the season pass, delivery profitability and land expansion.
%@ also unlocks: Activity, Market radar, Marvels progress, Foods to level up, Animal profitability, Pets, Available digs and Faction pet.
You can get %@ in two ways:
• Quarterly subscription: %@ every 3 months, auto-renewing.
• One-time payment: %@, paid once, with no renewals.
Prices shown are in US dollars; the store may show the equivalent in your currency and include any taxes that apply in your country. The price that applies is always the one shown in the store when you confirm the purchase.
You can also get %@ by redeeming a Google Play promo code given to you by the developer (for example, to test the app). Codes are managed by Google Play, are personal, single-use and expire on the date shown; they cannot be exchanged for money or resold. A one-time payment plan code unlocks Pro just as if you had bought it.

Toda la información se guarda únicamente: All information is stored only on your device: preferences, the last known %@ status and the last copy of your farm in the app's storage and caches in the app's folder. None of this is sent to the developer.
